latestVersion.changelog:
Plant Fiber Cordage Making Basics 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Guides users through all steps of making strong, biodegradable rope and cord from local wild/garden plants.
- Agent identifies plants from user photos, calculates fiber yield/strength, generates retting/drying schedules, and tracks quality.
- Includes safety checks for toxic lookalikes and irritation risk, plus daily reminders and protocol enforcement.
- Provides ready-to-use templates: plant field report, retting log, barter/trade scripts, and production dashboard.
- Human performs all physical harvesting, processing, twisting, and testing; agent manages planning, math, and documentation.
- Aims to help users rebuild self-reliance in rope-making and create tradeable/repairable cordage.
